verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe built-in Logfire instrumentation where 'a trace is generated for the agent run, and spans are emitted for each model request and tool call,' giving full visibility into LLM calls and tool invocations in an observability UI. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of this pattern (one engineer mentions pairing Pydantic AI with Langfuse in production). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on screenshots or reports of the Logfire UI itself, and confirmation of trace fidelity at scale beyond vendor docs.
